entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The aides quickly readied a side ro..."
entries.dialogueText: The aides quickly readied a side room for us. We stepped in and sat across from one another.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will be direct. Are you going to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will be direct. Are you going to support Lespia stealing our share in the MITZ?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel barked out a laugh."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel barked out a laugh.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I warned you that the Lespians wer..."
entries.dialogueText: "I warned you that the Lespians were a menace to the Trade Zone. You didn't listen to me, and this is your reward."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""In the end, it is Morella's decisi..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the end, it is Morella's decision, not mine. I am obligated to support any nationalization plan that Saltana puts forward."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""And even if I wasn't... your kingd..."
entries.dialogueText: "And even if I wasn't... your kingdom is arguably a greater threat than Lespia at this point."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I am sorry. But that's the way it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry. But that's the way it has to be."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Chancellor Hegel, I must insist th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chancellor Hegel, I must insist that you do not vote for the latest proposal. It was amended without Rizia's knowledge."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Obviously, I am against Alvarez an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Obviously, I am against Alvarez and his cronies snapping up a bigger share of South Merkopa's largest gold resource."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just out of curiosity, how are you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just out of curiosity, how are you planning on voting today?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know you are helping Saltana sto..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you are helping Saltana stoke internal rebellion in my kingdom. I just wanted to tell you that I don't care."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""If I knew where she was, why the h..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I knew where she was, why the hell would I tell you?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""From what I have heard, Vina Toras..."
entries.dialogueText: "From what I have heard, Vina Toras fled Rizia to escape the archaic marriage bond being forced upon her by her father."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Don't worry. The chances of the ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. The chances of the new proposal passing are roughly that of a snowball in hell."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you know where my daughter is?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you know where my daughter is?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""But you, Mr. Toras, are arguably a..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you, Mr. Toras, are arguably a greater threat than Alvarez at this point."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed without mirth."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed without mirth.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: !(RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed == true && RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows == true && RiziaDLC.Morella_Sabotage_Plans_Discovered == false)
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Morella_Sabotage_Plans_Discovered"] == false) == false

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""From what I have heard, Vina Toras..."
entries.dialogueText: "From what I have heard, Vina Toras was being kept in a golden cage -- allowed neither power nor the ability to choose her own husband."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You and the Morellan prime ministe..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and the Morellan prime minister must cease your provocations at once. The last thing any of us wants is bloodshed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're still planning on voting th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're still planning on voting the same way, right?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me sternly."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me sternly.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Why are you asking me? You'll find..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why are you asking me? You'll find out in five minutes, anyway."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Don't worry, Mr. Toras. Everything..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry, Mr. Toras. Everything will go exactly as planned."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How's everything back home?""
entries.dialogueText: "How's everything back home?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Exactly as *who* planned?""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly as *who* planned?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. That's all I wanted to know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. That's all I wanted to know."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What will it take for you to give..."
entries.dialogueText: "What will it take for you to give me some extra reassurance?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good point. Let's head to the vote.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good point. Let's head to the vote."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If your mind has changed... what w..."
entries.dialogueText: "If your mind has changed... what will it take to change it back?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not disrespect the King of Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not disrespect the King of Rizia, Chancellor. I am warning you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please. There must be something Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please. There must be something Rizia can offer you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is there anything I can do in exch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is there anything I can do in exchange for a little extra reassurance?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How can you say that? I thought th..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can you say that? I thought the West was your greatest nemesis."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""It is not the West that we in Valg..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not the West that we in Valgsland are fighting, Mr. Toras. It is the boot on the necks of the oppressed everywhere."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""And with your insistence on waging..."
entries.dialogueText: "And with your insistence on waging an unjust war, Rizia is wearing the biggest boot of all."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""And with your violent actions in Z..."
entries.dialogueText: "And with your violent actions in Zille, Rizia is wearing the biggest boot of all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A pity. But I understand. I will n..."
entries.dialogueText: "A pity. But I understand. I will not try to change your mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's great to know. Let's head t..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's great to know. Let's head to the vote, then."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you're saying there's no chance..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you're saying there's no chance. Zero."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave a curt nod. We left the roo..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave a curt nod. We left the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, if the shoe fits...""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, if the shoe fits..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He folded his arms."
entries.dialogueText: He folded his arms.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""That's very wise of you.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's very wise of you."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Shall we get this over with?""
entries.dialogueText: "Shall we get this over with?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured to the door, and we lef..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured to the door, and we left the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He continued to wear an inscrutable..."
entries.dialogueText: He continued to wear an inscrutable expression.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Let's get this over with, shall we?""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's get this over with, shall we?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We left the room."
entries.dialogueText: We left the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't understand. There have b..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't understand. There have been extenuating circumstances."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And you? How much damage have you..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you? How much damage have you caused by encouraging societies to rip each other apart in the name of your 'revolution'?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He rolled his eyes."
entries.dialogueText: He rolled his eyes.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""A muscle must tear before it can g..."
entries.dialogueText: "A muscle must tear before it can grow stronger."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""You'll find that out for yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "You'll find that out for yourself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please. Isn't there anything my ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please. Isn't there anything my kingdom can do to sway your vote?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Mr. Toras, I have no idea what you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Toras, I have no idea what you're talking about."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Mr. Toras, I have no idea what you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Toras, I have no idea what you're talking about."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""With your campaign of terror, you..."
entries.dialogueText: "With your campaign of terror, you are sowing the seeds for your kingdom's own demise."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""But I am glad that you have accept..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I am glad that you have accepted the inevitability of revolution. All kingdoms must, in time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's all in the service of reforms..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's all in the service of reforms that will transform Rizia. You'll see."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""All I see is a deranged bull, char..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I see is a deranged bull, charging at the people in the stands instead of the man waving the flag."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Your monarchy has sown the seeds o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your monarchy has sown the seeds of its own revolution. They did not need our help to sprout."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stop lying. You've been plotting t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stop lying. You've been plotting the downfall of Rizia since you lost Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Help me quell this threat, and we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Help me quell this threat, and we will defeat the West together."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""You, King Romus Toras, want to def..."
entries.dialogueText: "You, King Romus Toras, want to defeat the West?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""You expect me to believe that afte..."
entries.dialogueText: "You expect me to believe that after you sold your island to ATO?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I see no use in speaking to you fu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see no use in speaking to you further."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He folded his arms."
entries.dialogueText: He folded his arms.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""If you are serious about that, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you are serious about that, there is precisely one thing you can offer."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""There is precisely one thing you c..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is precisely one thing you can offer."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Your island, Caleqabiz. Allow Valg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your island, Caleqabiz. Allow Valgsland and the CSP to use it as a base of operations."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""You have a very vivid imagination.""
entries.dialogueText: "You have a very vivid imagination."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are a pragmatic man, Mr. Hegel..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are a pragmatic man, Mr. Hegel. You know that world leaders do not have to agree on everything to help each other out."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""You and I do not even agree on wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and I do not even agree on what constitutes basic decency."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""We will suffer through today. And..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will suffer through today. And then our paths will not cross again."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""You have sold your kingdom out to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have sold your kingdom out to Lespia and ATO. No offer under the sun would convince me."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Good day.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good day."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He huffed impatiently."
entries.dialogueText: He huffed impatiently.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Good, as it happens. Valgsland gai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good, as it happens. Valgsland gained a new ally recently."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I didn't come here for small talk,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't come here for small talk, Mr. Toras."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Now you want to make a deal?""
entries.dialogueText: "Now you want to make a deal?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""You and your crown of stolen gold...."
entries.dialogueText: "You and your crown of stolen gold... They are coming for it, Mr. Toras."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""You don't need it. You can rely on..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't need it. You can rely on my cooperation."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""But if it's a closer bond with Val..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if it's a closer bond with Valgsland you want, I do have one offer for you..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled mysteriously."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled mysteriously.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""You sold your own island to Lespia..."
entries.dialogueText: "You sold your own island to Lespia and ATO. No offer under the sun would convince me."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Entirely out of the goodness of yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Entirely out of the goodness of your heart."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""You'll be compensated fairly, of c..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll be compensated fairly, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're insane. No amount of money..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're insane. No amount of money is worth that much."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. If that's what it will take,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. If that's what it will take, Caleqabiz will be yours."
entries.menuText: "Fine. If that's what it will take, Caleqabiz will be yours." [+4 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My kingdom's claim to the Aureus g..."
entries.dialogueText: "My kingdom's claim to the Aureus gas field rests on the resource's proximity to Caleqabiz. I will not weaken it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our kingdom could use the extra in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our kingdom could use the extra income. Why not? Let's make a deal."
entries.menuText: "Our kingdom could use the extra income. Why not? Let's make a deal." [+4 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The CSP already has its hooks in M..."
entries.dialogueText: "The CSP already has its hooks in Morella. Now you want to position yourselves on our other side? Never."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only if you call me 'Comrade Romus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only if you call me 'Comrade Romus'."
entries.menuText: "Only if you call me 'Comrade Romus'." [+4 Budget]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He snorted."
entries.dialogueText: He snorted.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""We have a deal, comrade.""
entries.dialogueText: "We have a deal, comrade."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Suit yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Suit yourself."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""A pleasure cooperating with you, M..."
entries.dialogueText: "A pleasure cooperating with you, Mr. Toras."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He reached out and shook my hand fi..."
entries.dialogueText: He reached out and shook my hand firmly.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Then my vote is yours.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then my vote is yours."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He reached out and shook my hand fi..."
entries.dialogueText: He reached out and shook my hand firmly.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I assume we're done here.""
entries.dialogueText: "I assume we're done here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: He shrugged.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""That was my idea. I don't have any..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was my idea. I don't have any others."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This had better be worth it.""
entries.dialogueText: "This had better be worth it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, let's get this over with.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, let's get this over with."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""That's not for me to judge.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's not for me to judge."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you know where my daughter is?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you know where my daughter is?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""If I knew where she was, why the h..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I knew where she was, why the hell would I tell you?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""From what I have heard, Vina Toras..."
entries.dialogueText: "From what I have heard, Vina Toras fled Rizia to escape the archaic marriage bond being forced upon her by her father."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""From what I have heard, Vina Toras..."
entries.dialogueText: "From what I have heard, Vina Toras was being kept in a golden cage -- allowed neither the ability to advance her career nor choose her own life partner."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed without mirth."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed without mirth.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for your flexibility, Ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your flexibility, Chancellor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want the truth. Is Valgsland aid..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want the truth. Is Valgsland aiding the new revolutionary movement in Rizia?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He spoke calmly."
entries.dialogueText: He spoke calmly.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Revolutions cannot be started from..."
entries.dialogueText: "Revolutions cannot be started from the outside, Mr. Toras. Your people planted the seeds of their own liberation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We discussed this. You yourself sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "We discussed this. You yourself said the time would be right someday."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Seeds don't grow without nourishme..."
entries.dialogueText: "Seeds don't grow without nourishment. You've been watering them from afar."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want those seeds to sprout as mu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want those seeds to sprout as much as you do. I am working with this movement, not against it."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I am skeptical that even an 'enlig..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am skeptical that even an 'enlightened' monarch such as yourself would be willing to hand the reins of government to the working class."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""But I'm ready to be positively sur..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I'm ready to be positively surprised."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled conspiratorially."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled conspiratorially.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Did I? I don't recall. It was very..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did I? I don't recall. It was very late at night."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""But I am happy to see that your po..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I am happy to see that your politician -- Sotelato, was it? -- has finally put the Rizian working class on a path to self-determination."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If your government is meddling wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "If your government is meddling with my kingdom's affairs in any way, you will pay."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Duly noted. Is that all?""
entries.dialogueText: "Duly noted. Is that all?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""But if the time were ever right fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if the time were ever right for revolution in your country, it would be now, after you dissolved your father's sad attempt at a parliament."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Drop the high-and-mighty act, Chan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Drop the high-and-mighty act, Chancellor. The CSP would love a bigger foothold in South Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I heard you might be changing..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I heard you might be changing your vote today?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. Let's get this board vote ove..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Let's get this board vote over with."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""As have you, from what I gather.""
entries.dialogueText: "As have you, from what I gather."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Rizia would have much to gain from..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia would have much to gain from that as well, you know."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I don't have the time or inclinati..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't have the time or inclination to listen to your accusations. We've got a vote to sit through."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I only hope that whenever your new..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only hope that whenever your new government comes to fruition, it has the sense to reverse that decision. Until then, I don't have a thing to say to you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We once spoke of big changes comin..."
entries.dialogueText: "We once spoke of big changes coming to Rizia. I believe the time is now right for them."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hegel_OpenToRevolution"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_TalkToAdarfo_AskedManus"] == true)) == false

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hint of a smile appeared on his..."
entries.dialogueText: The hint of a smile appeared on his face.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Yes. I believe so as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I believe so as well."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""It's heartening to hear that.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's heartening to hear that."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Although I am worried that without..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although I am worried that without the workers' movement leading the charge, the 'new' Rizia will suspiciously resemble the old one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't need to worry about that..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't need to worry about that. Just know that we'll be open to closer ties with Valgsland going forward."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I assure you these changes are bei..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you these changes are being made with the working class in mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That is the least of my concerns...."
entries.dialogueText: "That is the least of my concerns. I'll be lucky to pass even a bare-bones version of reform."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""If it's closer ties with Valgsland..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it's closer ties with Valgsland you want, there is something I can offer you right away."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I should hope so.""
entries.dialogueText: "I should hope so."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""You are the monarch, are you not?..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are the monarch, are you not? Exercise your power while you still can."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""How can you say that when your mos..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can you say that when your most strategic island has been leased to our ideological rival?"

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Narrator: "Hegel barked out a laugh."]

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""While you are still monarch of Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "While you are still monarch of Rizia, there is one thing I would ask of you."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I would take you to task for leasi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would take you to task for leasing your most strategic island to our direct rivals in Lespia. But I'll save that conversation for your predecessor, whoever he or she may be."
